draft.briefing: Hey, you're in Indiranagar! It's one of Bengaluru's most expensive, cosmopolitan neighbourhoods, and the little park at CMH Road and 100 Ft Road has the city's only outdoor vertical garden.
draft.hungryLine: Bengaluru loves its dosas, ice cream and juice stands, so grab a cheap sugarcane juice or fresh coconut while you wander.

moodReplies.show-me-around: Cornerstone Park is a 9 min walk, the Indiranagar metro station is about 10 minutes away, and old Ulsoor is a 19 min walk.
moodReplies.somewhere-to-chill: Sit a while in Cornerstone Park, right in the heart of Indiranagar, and check out the vertical garden.
moodReplies.surprise-me: The Indiranagar metro station was one of the first six stations on Namma Metro, opened to the public on 20 October 2011.

spots.name: Cornerstone Park
spots.detail: 9 min walk · The city's only outdoor vertical garden

spots.name: Ulsoor
spots.detail: 19 min walk · One of Bengaluru's oldest neighbourhoods, full of temples and a market

spots.name: Domlur inscriptions and hero stones
spots.detail: 22 min walk · 18 old Tamil and Kannada inscriptions at the Chokkanathaswamy Temple

legends.title: Stones for heroes
legends.body: Around the Chokkanathaswamy Temple in Domlur you'll find inscribed stone pillars and hero stones. Hero stones were raised to remember someone who died with honour in battle.

tips.title: Hop on the Purple Line.
tips.body: Indiranagar station sits on CMH Road on Namma Metro's east-west Purple Line.

tips.title: Cool off at a juice stand.
tips.body: Young coconut and sugarcane juice stands are everywhere in Bengaluru and great for staying cool.

story.title: Early settlements
story.body: Binnamangala, right nearby, was one of the early settlements of Bengaluru. In Domlur, old temple walls and pillars carry 18 inscriptions in Tamil and Kannada.

story.title: From cantonment to state
story.body: Neighbouring Domlur was part of the British-run Bangalore Civil and Military Station under the Madras Presidency. It was handed over to Mysore State in 1949.

story.title: Village into city
story.body: Binnamangala Manavarthe Kaval, a former village with 10,516 people in 1991, was merged into the city corporation on 7 December 1995.

story.title: Metro and a new park
story.body: The Indiranagar metro station opened on 20 October 2011. A year later Cornerstone Park was renovated and opened on Swami Vivekananda's 150th birth anniversary.

story.title: Affluent and cosmopolitan
story.body: Indiranagar is now one of the priciest neighbourhoods in Bengaluru. Next door Domlur is full of software offices like Embassy Golf Links.
